title: Former Senior Strategic Account Executive at Twilio Believes A2P Messaging Will Decline as Voice AI’s Pipeline Boost Proves Temporary
expert: Former Senior Strategic Account Executive at Twilio (left just under 3 years ago)
verdict: A former strategic AE (left ~3 years ago) says over 75% of large North American renewals took 10%–20% price cuts to lock in commitments, and top senders get 90%–95% off list.

Gross profit dollar growth vs organic re: 🔴 **>75% of NA renewals cut price 10%–20% for commitments** (first-hand, dated) vs 2026-11-09 call (net pricing down single digits): consistent. → Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue) ↓ {c7}
🟡 **Carrier fees ~5pts of a 116% net expansion rate; up to 80% of a high-volume invoice** vs mgmt ~4pts of DBNE (SB #64364): consistent. → Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue) → {c20}
Messaging organic growth (ex-fees): 🔴 **A2P messaging volume −25% over five years** (estimate) vs Third Bridge 2FA moving to push and passkeys (SB #64480): consistent. → Tenet 2 (organic ≥10%) ↓ {c12}

changes: Carrier fees **~5pts** of 116% net expansion (hearsay) vs mgmt 3Q26 ~4pts of 114% DBNE (SB #64364): consistent.
A2P volume **−25% over five years** (estimate) vs Third Bridge former architect, 2FA moving to push and passkeys (SB #64480): consistent.
Renewal price cuts **10%–20%** vs 2026-11-09 Expert Call (former AE: net effective pricing down single digits y/y): consistent.
Conversation Relay **\$0.07 a minute** vs 2026-11-06 Expert Call (RingCentral VP: \$0.079 all-in Voice AI): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (organic growth ≥10%): ↓ — A2P volume −25% over five years (estimate) as authentication moves to operator APIs and OTT.
Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue): ↓ — top senders at 90%–95% off list run low single-digit margins; renewals cut 10%–20%.
Tenet 1 (AI agent layer): → — voice AI pipeline improved but the expert sees experimentation, with \$0.07/min Relay too expensive at scale.
Tenet 5 (carrier moat): ↓ — Sinch, Infobip and Telnyx win large messaging senders; Bandwidth in voice.
